column7: AddProjectMember, SetProjectMemberRole (new member), InviteMember and AddUserToGroup ran the membership domain allowlist check, which loads the target user, before the granter ceiling, so a roles.assign holder who may not grant the role could tell from the refusal whether a user ID exists and whether its email is on the allowlist. The ceiling now runs first; a refused actor gets one answer for every target (REST: TestMemberGrantHandlers_UnauthorizedActorIdenticalAnswer; class guard TestTargetLookupsFollowActorAuthorization). Found in the OWNERSHIP-ORACLE-1 sibling sweep after #3794
